# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Hunters Estate Agents are delighted to present to the market this excellent two-bedroom property, extending to approximately 55 sq. m. / 592 sq. ft. No. 11 Monkstown Square is an attractive own-door, ground-floor apartment, ideally situated within a quiet and secure development of just 28 apartments, located just off Monkstown Avenue.
